question: Identify the L1_model associated with each model (specified by name and version) that occurs most frequently for each status ('strong' or 'soft'), along with the number of times it occurs. A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score. It has a 'soft' status if the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models equals the 'Stack' model's test score. Count how many times each L1_model is associated with a 'strong' or 'soft' status across all models, and determine which L1_model has the highest occurrence for each status.
sql:
WITH step_data AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_non_stack_score
  FROM model_score
  GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_status AS (
  SELECT name, version,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stack_score > max_non_stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_strong,
    MAX(CASE WHEN stack_score = max_non_stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_soft
  FROM step_data
  GROUP BY name, version
),
model_with_l1 AS (
  SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.has_strong, ms.has_soft, m.L1_model
  FROM model_status ms
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model FROM model) m 
    ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
),
status_l1_counts AS (
  SELECT 'strong' as status, L1_model, SUM(has_strong) as cnt
  FROM model_with_l1
  GROUP BY L1_model
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'soft' as status, L1_model, SUM(has_soft) as cnt
  FROM model_with_l1
  GROUP BY L1_model
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT status, L1_model, cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM status_l1_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, CAST(cnt AS INTEGER) as count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY status

-- or soft (any step: stack = non-stack)
WITH step_status AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_non_stack_score,
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) > MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) THEN 'strong'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) = MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) THEN 'soft'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as step_status
  FROM model_score
  GROUP BY name, version, step
)
SELECT name, version, 
  MAX(CASE WHEN step_status = 'strong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_strong,
  MAX(CASE WHEN step_status = 'soft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_soft
FROM step_status
GROUP BY name, version
HAVING has_strong = 1 AND has_soft = 1
